fullContentHtml:
IOB Generalist/SO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 291 Manager, Assistant Manager and Senior Manager Posts - Complete Details

Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 291 Generalist/SO posts. The online application process will be conducted from 29 August 2026 to 29 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, iob.bank.in.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 28.08.2026
  • Application Start Date : 29.08.2026
  • Application Last Date : 15.09.2026
  • Notification Release Date : 28.08.2026
  • Opening Date of Online Registration : 29.08.2026
  • Closing Date of Online Registration : 15.09.2026
  • Online Examination Date : Not specified in the notification
  • Interview Date : Not specified in the notification

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Generalist / Specialist Officers (14 posts)
  • Application Start Date : 29.08.2026
  • Application Last Date : 15.09.2026
  • Salary/Pay Scale : JMGS I: ₹48,480–85,290; MMGS II: ₹64,820–93,960; MMGS III: ₹85,920–1,05,280
  • Opening Date of Online Registration : 29.08.2026
  • Closing Date of Online Registration : 15.09.2026
  • Payment of Application Fee / Intimation Charges : 29.08.2026 to 15.09.2026
  • Post Code : Post Name
  • Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe : 5 years
  • Scale / Grade : Scale of Pay (₹)
  • SC / ST / PWD : ₹175/- (inclusive of GST)
  • All Others (including OBC & EWS) : ₹1,000/- (inclusive of GST)

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
